names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 27 octombrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Dimitrie cel Nou, Ocrotitorul Bucureștilor».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 27 Οκτωβρίου, «Όσιος Δημήτριος ο Νέος (Μπασαράμπης)», with the rank word and the epithets left off.

Read whole off the title on the name link behind his line for 26 октября ст. ст., «Димитрий Басарбовский (Бассарабовский), Болгарский, прп.», with the rank word left off; the bracketed second spelling is the calendar's own. The line on the day page declines the name and gives it without the second spelling.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «8 июля (Перенесение мощей)», the translation of his relics to Bucharest. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it. The Romanian row keeps him on 27 octombrie, a day later in the menologion than this calendar does; neither page explains the difference and neither is changed.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Димитрия Басарбовского, Болгарского (1685).»
doxologia.ro, 27 octombrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Dimitrie cel Nou, Ocrotitorul Bucureștilor»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Δημήτριος ο Νέος (Μπασαράμπης)»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/4094/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man — saint.gr calls him «ο προστάτης της ρουμανικής πρωτευούσης», the protector of the Romanian capital, which is what doxologia's «Ocrotitorul Bucureștilor» says. It dates him by the century and the reign — «Έζησε τον 13ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στην περίοδο της βασιλείας των Πέτρου και Ιωάννου Ασάν» — and gives no year, so the `dates` object is that century. Basarabovo is placed twenty kilometres from the Danube on Bulgarian soil, the monastery he was tonsured in near the river Lom, and the relics in the metropolitan church of Saints Constantine and Helen at Bucharest since 1774; no coordinate is proposed from any of it. No hymn is printed, and the page's long section of wonders is not retold here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

death.note: Two calendars disagree by nearly five centuries and neither reading is chosen. days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(1685)» after his name on 26 октября ст. ст. and its life says «Скончался в 1685 г.»; saint.gr, from which this folder was first read, says «Έζησε τον 13ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στην περίοδο της βασιλείας των Πέτρου και Ιωάννου Ασάν» and gives no year. No third source was read to break it. The interval holds both readings, as docs/CORPUS.md §3 requires. Read 4 October 2026.
